Game Overview

At its heart, Stack Rocket is a building game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Stack Rocket is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Stack Rocket?

Stack Rocket is a free building game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Stack Rocket free to play?

Yes, Stack Rocket is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
